name: Hacienda Yaxcopoil

dates.altered: Began as a cattle ranch and later became a henequen plantation; acquired in 1864 by Donaciano Garcia Rejon Mazo and Maria Monica Galera Encalada and held by their descendants since; a well and pumps of the early 20th century still working.
dates.note: The node's exemplar says 'Founded in the 17th century; the surviving buildings are largely of the 19th-century henequen era'. The article gives no construction date for any building; it dates the 1864 purchase and the early-20th-century machinery and nothing else.

refs.title: Hacienda Yaxcopoil - Wikipedia, la enciclopedia libre

survey.prepared: No revision date was printed in the extract. AN ENCYCLOPEDIA ARTICLE AND NOT A REGISTER.

quotes.text: Yaxcopoil fue considerada una de las principales haciendas en Yucatán. La propiedad en su máximo esplendor cubría 12,000 hectáreas. Comenzó como un rancho ganadero y más tarde como una plantación de henequén. No obstante, con el paso del tiempo y con los continuos procesos de cambio político, social y económico en la región, su extensión se vio reducida a menos del 3% de su antigua superficie.

La casa principal de amplios salones, altos techos, y espaciosos corredores, está rodeada de extensos jardines con una gama infinita de colorido y vegetación exuberante, que nos sitúan en un ambiente único e incomparable.

En la huerta se encuentra la piscina con sus vestidores, el tanque de riego y la noria con su motor y bombas Americanas de principios del siglo XX, que siguen trabajando extrayendo el agua para el uso cotidiano.

measurements.name: estate_area_ha
measurements.note: AN AREA IN HECTARES, AND THE SCHEMA'S UNIT ENUM CANNOT EXPRESS ONE, so no `value` and no `unit` are recorded. 12,000 ha is about 46 square miles. It is the LAND, not the casco, and this node's own text is careful that those are different things.

measurements.as_printed: menos del 3% de su antigua superficie
measurements.note: An upper bound -- the article says LESS than three per cent -- of the land, after the agrarian reform this node names as the end of the type.

note: Tranche 3, 5 Sep 2026. THE SECOND QUOTE IS THE NODE'S CENTRAL ELEMENT DESCRIBED AND NOT MEASURED: 'espaciosos corredores' -- spacious corredores -- with no depth, no bay count and no storey height. This node's kit binds a corredor depth of 8.2 to 13.1 ft and not one source in this cluster states one, which is the single most useful thing this record reports.
